svg.title: Non-slip mono loop — how to tie it
svg.desc: Non-slip mono loop, in 6 steps. Tie a simple overhand knot in the tippet about six inches from the tag end, leaving it open. Pass the tag through the hook eye and back through the overhand knot from the same side it exited. Wrap the tag around the standing line — more turns for lighter tippet, fewer for heavy. Bring the tag back through the overhand knot, entering the same side it originally exited. Wet it, seat the wraps first, then pull the standing line to close the loop to size. Trim the tag close.
